items.raw_excerpt: Some feelings in Mexico can only be properly expressed using national idioms that no Spanish class will likely ever teach you.
items.summary_en: Some feelings in Mexico can only be properly expressed with unique national idioms. These words cannot be learned in any Spanish class. They reflect local culture that only people in Mexico truly understand.

items.raw_excerpt: A Joint Action Committee comprising the Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha, Dalit Sangharsha Samiti, Parisarakagi Naavu, Team Mysuru, and several pro-Kannada and progressive organisations has strongly condemned the alleged felling of trees and destruction of the environment in the name of preparations for the proposed Kambala event during Mysuru Dasara.
items.summary_en: Local organizations in Karnataka have condemned the cutting of trees for Kambala preparations during the Mysuru Dasara festival. They say the environmental damage for the traditional buffalo racing event must be stopped.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카주의 여러 시민단체가 마이소르 다사라 축제 기간 중 카감바 대회 준비를 위한 벌채를 강하게 규탄했다. 전통적인 물소 경주 행사 준비를 위한 환경 훼손을 중단해야 한다고 주장하고 있다.
items.title_en: Community groups protest tree cutting for buffalo racing festival

items.summary_en: Poland's president signed a law that bans keeping dogs and cats on chains at home. From next year, pets must live inside the house, in a fenced garden, or in a large enough kennel with daily exercise. The ban passed after months of debate between lawmakers and the president over earlier versions of the bill.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드 대통령이 집에서 개와 고양이를 사슬에 묶어 기르는 것을 금지하는 법에 서명했다. 내년부터 반려동물은 집 안이나 울타리가 쳐진 마당, 또는 충분히 넓은 개집에서 키워야 하며, 개집에 있는 개는 매일 밖에서 운동해야 한다. 이 법은 기존 금지안이 대통령에게 거부된 후 수개월에 걸친 수정과 논의 끝에 통과되었다.
items.title_en: Poland bans chaining dogs and cats at home
items.title_ko: 폴란드, 개와 고양이를 집에서 사슬에 묶어 기르는 것 금지

items.raw_excerpt: La tercera ola de calor del verano en España ha dejado espectaculares registros en Sumacàrcer (Valencia).
items.summary_en: The town of Sumacàrcer in Valencia, Spain recorded an extreme heat sensation of 63 degrees Celsius. This was the highest temperature felt during Spain's third heat wave this summer. The small village drew attention for its remarkable weather record.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 발렌시아의 수마카르세르 마을에서 체감온도 63도를 기록했습니다. 올여름 스페인의 세 번째 폭염 중 가장 높은 온도를 보인 것입니다. 작은 마을이 극한 기온으로 주목을 받았습니다.
items.title_en: Small Spanish Town Hits 63-Degree Heat Record
items.title_original: El pueblo valenciano que marca el récord de la tercera ola de calor: una sensación térmica de hasta 63 grados - 20Minutos

items.raw_excerpt: Tensions have been running high between the US and its historical allies in Europe, but how does this affect Americans living in Italy? We asked The Local's readers about their experiences.
items.summary_en: Many Americans living in Italy say Italians sympathize with their situation. The article explores how US-Europe tensions affect everyday life for Americans abroad. Readers share personal stories about navigating cultural and political differences.
